correctness.rationale: Log-odds map H(s)=s+a(b-sigma(s)) is smoothly conjugate on (0,1); the exact rational outward interval checker proves the four-return center residual and derivative margins in the two intervals of radius 0.002, yielding unique contracting return fixed points by the mean value/Banach principle. Disjoint H^2(J_i) excludes period 1/2 and disjoint 0..3 phases excludes rephasing. H has exactly two critical points for a>4 and strictly negative Schwarzian, so the classical critical-basin theorem bounds attracting cycles by two; 0,1 are repelling. No claim of only two periodic orbits overall.
